source_of_truth: workspace-packages with src runtime compatibility surfaces

assets.name: Semantic Layout, Spacing, Radius, Typography Roles
Card
assets.notes: Card and card-like panel surfaces use semantic radius.card at 12px and remain borderless; radius.md remains a compatibility alias for non-card surfaces.

assets.name: Public Copy Table
assets.notes: First-batch high-risk page copy is keyed in src/i18n/translations.ts and mirrored in copy-table; Indonesian entries use current runtime strings where available and remain marked for native review where applicable.

assets.name: Illustration Registry
assets.notes: Approved as the owned-illustration governance registry. Runtime pages currently use registered IconSurface/AppIcon fallbacks; unknown-source bitmap/SVG illustration assets remain blocked until separately registered.

assets.name: LocalPinSecurityFlow
assets.notes: Approved as a governed high-risk local security flow. Runtime remains in PinSetupScreen with i18n copy, optional-default bypass, locked-state unlock recovery, and graph dependency coverage.

assets.name: Design Public Assets Runtime Facade
assets.notes: Page-facing typed facade. It re-exports runtime compatibility surfaces only; it does not copy public asset implementations.

assets.name: AppViewport
assets.notes: Web/Codex product-page preview uses the governed 390 x 844 native app canvas with token-bound radius.sheet clipping; native apps keep real device dimensions.

assets.name: ProductControlPanel developer tool
assets.notes: Independent draggable debug module outside AppViewport; it must not be clipped by the product app canvas.

assets.name: Security Center Product Contract Package
assets.notes: Contract-first Security Center package. Runtime route /settings/security-center is planned for the next App implementation stage; /settings/security-log remains compatibility detail surface.

assets.name: Security Center Overview Pattern
assets.notes: Planned pattern for alert banner, security score, account security cards, GSL summary, and device/login entry.

assets.name: Security Verification Pattern
assets.notes: Planned shared verification and high-risk confirmation pattern for TOTP/email OTP/GSL cancel actions.
